==Quotes==
'''In town'''
While killing players after Grenth wins the finale:
:''"<character name> be nimble, <character name> be quick, <character name> I'll poke both your eyes out with sticks!"''

:''"<character name>, there's nothing that you can do, when you let your guard down I am coming for you!"''

'''Dwayna Vs Grenth''':

When spoken to be a member of either team:
:''"They say 'tis a season of love and goodwill, I say 'tis a season of making you ill!"''

When Dwayna's team scores:
:''"Waaaa! You're a mean one, <character name>!"''

When Grenth's team scores:
:''"Another present smashed all to bits, Wintersday is really the...er...best!"''
:''"Nothing but this will give me great joy: to see Dwayna's children weep o'er broken toys."''

'''During How the Grentches Stole Wintersday''':
:''"I am Grenth's servant, at your command. Tell me who dies, and it's all well in hand!"''

==Items dropped==
*[[Glob of Frozen Ectoplasm]] (only during [[You're a Mean One, Mr. Grenth]])

==Notes==
*They [[spawn]] and drop [[Present (bundle)|Presents]] in [[Lion's Arch]] and [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] during a [[Wintersday/Finale|Wintersday finale]] after Grenth wins. They chase players and cause instant [[death]] when reaching melee range. 
*If a grentch targets a player that they cannot reach, the player will be [[teleport]]ed to the grentch.

==Trivia==
*They appeared in [[Tomb of the Primeval Kings]] only during [[Wintersday 2005]].
*Prior to the [[Feedback:Game updates/20111215#Wintersday Events 2|December 15, 2011 update]], they appeared in [[Ascalon City]], [[Droknar's Forge]], Lion's Arch, and Kamadan during Wintersday for the [[Present (bundle)#Grentch activity|grentch activity]].
:*Dialogue:
::''"I'm looking for presents that I can destroy, try to sneak past and I'll break all your toys!"''
:*Quote:
::After destroying presents:
:::''"Another present smashed all to bits, Wintersday is really the...er...best!"''

*These monsters are most likely a reference to [[w:The Grinch|The Grinch]] from [[w:How the Grinch Stole Christmas!|How the Grinch Stole Christmas!]], a book by [[w:Dr. Seuss|Dr.Seuss]].
*Their appearance is similar to that of the [[w:Gremlins|Gremlins]].
